author: neal_illustrator
title: Looking for artists for comic and animation teams
content: Heyo! I’m doing an all call looking for artists to help build out my comic and animation teams! I think it’s time to try and ease up some of the stress and expand my team! I’m excited to see y’all’s portfolios! I’m so excited to have the team grow! I’m like a little studio now! Stay stellar!! Application Links are in my linktree (in bio)

author: harrier_studio
title: Harrier Studio hiring illustrators and comic artists
content: HARRIER STUDIO IS HIRING! OPEN POSITIONS: Illustrator (Full Stage), Sketch Artist (Drafter), Line Artist, Colorist, Compositor, Storyboard Artist, Styling Artist, Typesetter. Kirim CV & Portofolio ke: harrierstdrecruitment@gmail.com (Subjek: Nama – Posisi – CV & Portofolio). Dibuka sampai semua posisi terisi.

author: oaktree_comics
title: Hiring artist for picture book
content: WE’RE HIRING ARTISTS! Oak Tree Comics is looking to hire an artist for a picture book. The envisioned drawing style blends modern comic book imagery with the warmth and kindness of a classic picture book. Thematically, the story explores urban wildlife coexistence through humor and lots of heart. Applicants should have a portfolio of picture book, comics, or sequential art. For full submission guidelines, please visit the link in our bio!

author: attenboroughac
title: Open call for mural painter
content: Open Call: Painting a mural for an exhibition at Attenborough Arts Centre. Jemisha Maadhavji is looking for artist/s to paint a floral wallpaper mural on one 10m wall. Commission fee £750. Materials will be provided. Duration of job - 3 days: start date 28th September 2026 to 30th September 2026. Location Attenborough Arts Centre, Leicester. Please send a short bio, portfolio and examples of your work to jemishamaadhavji7@gmail.com and Cc mybc1@leicester.ac.uk by 21st September 2026.
